title: Segment
description: A way of slicing up what an organisation serves (a region, a depot, a product line, a service tier), so a gap can say where it was found and a measure can be broken down the same way. Segments are a tree: the slicing itself is a Segment with no parent (Region), and its slices are its children (the northern region), the same shape Goal already uses for its levels. Not a BeneficiaryGroup: a group is who work is for, a segment is where a shortfall was observed, and a region or a service tier is not a group of people. See TAXONOMY.md D9.

name.description: Deprecated: the name is metadata.name, as Kubernetes keeps it. Read from a manifest saved before 2.6.0 and folded into metadata.name; never written.

parent.description: The dimension this is a value of, or the broader slice it sits inside. Absent for a dimension itself. A kind rule refuses a segment that is its own ancestor.

description.description: What falls inside this slice and what does not, precisely enough that two people counting it would agree.
